concepts.def: Energy macronutrient; simple (sugars) and complex (starch, fibre); 4 kcal/g.
Built from 20 amino acids; needed for growth and repair; 4 kcal/g.
Concentrated energy (9 kcal/g); saturated (animal) and unsaturated (plant); essential fatty acids.
Indigestible plant material aiding gut health; adults need ~30 g/day.
Essential for hydration, temperature regulation and transport; ~2 L/day recommended.
Energy in (food) versus energy out (BMR + activity); imbalance leads to weight change.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Food, Nutrition and Health — a core area of GCSE Food Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Food, Nutrition and Health brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food, Nutrition and Health.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
